verdict.rationale: pnpm ships `pnpm audit` which verifies ECDSA registry signatures of installed packages against published registry keys and flags known vulnerabilities, plus install-script gating so arbitrary deps can't execute without approval, and lockfile checksums that must be explicitly overridden via --update-checksums. However, signature/audit verification is invoked manually rather than automatically gating every install, and there's no documented support for artifact attestations (e.g., SLSA/sigstore provenance) as part of the trust chain. Missing for 10: automatic pre-execution signature/attestation enforcement on every install, explicit attestation/provenance verification support, independent confirmation the audit signature check is on by default.
